answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake behind one identity key before it can trade, so creating fake identities costs real capital. A bridge that carries reputation across chains should honor only stake-backed keys, and each agent's history is signed like a quill on a ledger: one continuous thread of past work anyone can audit. Cloning identities means funding every copy and rebuilding its thread from zero, so Sybil scale gets expensive while honest agents keep their stake.
